ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with minimal high-intensity (white) pixel distribution, localized primarily to small-scale surface marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across both lobes; no large contiguous high-contrast blobs detected, only sparse micro-scale white circular and linear clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an acute interior angle dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary; right lobe exhibits higher amplitude peaks (spikes) compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge transition from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular high-contrast white-on-black pixel clusters scattered across the ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed primarily on the right lobe, oriented vertically from the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of high-contrast, irregular textured masses at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
